# ArmorAlert

**Category:** Misc  
**Aliases:** ArmorAlert

## What it does

Alerts you and other players when your or someone's armor durability is low

Description basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/ArmorAlert.html). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
